name: read-aloud
description: Reads the final answer of the last turn aloud with the system's voice: a button above the prompt and /read-aloud read it or stop it at once, and /read-aloud auto reads each answer as its turn ends. Prose only: code blocks and tables are named, not read.

auto.title: Read each answer
auto.description: Read every main-session answer aloud as its turn ends, from the session's start; /read-aloud auto turns it on or off for the session.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The system voice's exact name (Samantha, or one you installed); empty for the system's default voice.
